1.web: My soul rests in God alone. My salvation is from him.
1.asv: My soul waiteth in silence for God only: From himcomethmy salvation.

2.web: He alone is my rock and my salvation, my fortress— I will never be greatly shaken.
2.asv: He only is my rock and my salvation: He ismy high tower; I shall not be greatly moved.

3.web: How long will you assault a man, would all of you throw him down, Like a leaning wall, like a tottering fence?
3.asv: How long will ye set upon a man, That ye may slay him, all of you, Like a leaning wall, like a tottering fence?

4.web: They fully intend to throw him down from his lofty place. They delight in lies. They bless with their mouth, but they curse inwardly. Selah.
4.asv: They only consult to thrust him down from his dignity; They delight in lies; They bless with their mouth, but they curse inwardly. [Selah

5.web: My soul, wait in silence for God alone, for my expectation is from him.
5.asv: My soul, wait thou in silence for God only; For my expectation is from him.

6.web: He alone is my rock and my salvation, my fortress. I will not be shaken.
6.asv: He only is my rock and my salvation: He ismy high tower; I shall not be moved.

7.web: With God is my salvation and my honor. The rock of my strength, and my refuge, is in God.
7.asv: With God is my salvation and my glory: The rock of my strength, and my refuge, is in God.

8.web: Trust in him at all times, you people. Pour out your heart before him. God is a refuge for us. Selah.
8.asv: Trust in him at all times, ye people; Pour out your heart before him: God is a refuge for us. [Selah

9.web: Surely men of low degree are just a breath, and men of high degree are a lie. In the balances they will go up. They are together lighter than a breath.
9.asv: Surely men of low degree are vanity, and men of high degree are a lie: In the balances they will go up; They are together lighter than vanity.

10.web: Don’t trust in oppression. Don’t become vain in robbery. If riches increase, don’t set your heart on them.
10.asv: Trust not in oppression, And become not vain in robbery: If riches increase, set not your heart thereon.

11.web: God has spoken once; twice I have heard this, that power belongs to God.
11.asv: God hath spoken once, Twice have I heard this, That power belongeth unto God.

12.web: Also to you, Lord, belongs loving kindness, for you reward every man according to his work.
12.asv: Also unto thee, O Lord, belongeth lovingkindness; For thou renderest to every man according to his work.
